say:1:1610544501:1.text: Cyran and Durella arrive on the scene to restore order. The area is utter chaos: the interrupted test, panicked students, and anxious teachers. The tension grows heavy with every passing moment.
say:1:1610544501:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷和杜瑞拉及时赶到了考试现场，试图平息事态。但周...

say:4:1610544502:1.text: Professor Zorya turns her attention to the frightened students, trying to restore order.
say:4:1610544502:1.source_cn: 佐尔娅老师并没有急着和你接触，而是走到一边开始维持秩序...
say:4:1610544502:1.male: Professor Zorya turns her attention to the frightened students, trying to restore order.
say:4:1610544502:1.female: Professor Zorya turns her attention to the frightened students, trying to restore order.

say:7:1610544503:2.text: Observing the chaos, you see Cyran staring at the spot where the headmaster fell. He shakes his head silently.
say:7:1610544503:2.source_cn: 你从远处看到，迪尔格雷瞥向校长倒下的方向，意味深长地摇...
say:7:1610544503:2.male: Observing the chaos, you see Cyran staring at the spot where the headmaster fell. He shakes his head silently.
say:7:1610544503:2.female: Observing the chaos, you see Cyran staring at the spot where the headmaster fell. He shakes his head silently.

say:8:1610544504:1.text: Everyone, as you can see, we have had a serious incident here.
say:8:1610544504:1.source_cn: 各位，如你们所见，现场出现了严重事故。

say:9:1610544505:1.text: Given the severity of this matter, I'm reporting it to the royal court immediately. As for the Lyceum's internal affairs...
say:9:1610544505:1.source_cn: 此事十分重大，我会通报王室相关人员。至于学校内部的事务……

say:11:1610544506:1.text: I am ordering an immediate lockdown. No one is authorized to leave the premises until we determine the cause of this incident.
say:11:1610544506:1.source_cn: 注意，为了查明事故原因，现场所有人未经允许，暂时不得离开！

say:13:1610544507:1.text: Durella, please reconsider! The headmaster's condition should not go public. Keeping everyone here will only cause panic and hinder the investigation.
say:13:1610544507:1.source_cn: 杜瑞拉，这不妥当！校长的情况尚未公开，现场不适合聚集这...

say:14:1610544508:1.text: We should let the students return to their dorms and question them later, one by one.
say:14:1610544508:1.source_cn: 让他们先回校舍休息，之后再挨个询问是更好的做法。

say:15:1610544509:1.text: No way. This concerns the headmaster himself. We will not let anyone escape until they have been cleared.
say:15:1610544509:1.source_cn: 不，事关校长，不能放跑任何一个可疑的人。

say:16:1610544510:1.text: They are all students of the Serene Lyceum. Our students! If they are to be considered suspects, you should first put all faculty members on your suspect list!
say:16:1610544510:1.source_cn: 他们都是莱希拉姆的学生，经由我们亲自教导。如果你就认为...

say:17:1610544511:1.text: Hmph, you make a good point. Now, do as the Deputy Headmistress requests!
say:17:1610544511:1.source_cn: 呵呵呵，多谢你的提醒，我会这么做的——记住，我是副校长！

say:18:1610544512:1.text: Guards! Check every student present, add them to a list for further investigation, and revoke their exit permissions. No one leaves the Lyceum.
say:18:1610544512:1.source_cn: 守卫，登记在场每个人的学生信息，将他们列入调查名单，限...
